title: arabis alpina subsp. brevifolia
intro: Arabis alpina subsp. brevifolia, commonly known as Alpine Rockcress, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Arabis alpina subsp. brevifolia include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
